units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:2">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> top <he>שלא … דן א׳</he> that one must not judge from mere guess (appearance).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:16">Aboth I, 16</cite> <he>אל תרבה לעשר א׳</he> in giving tithes do not give (even) too much by guessing (but measure accurately).
